scenarios.name: Sign-in page
scenarios.description: Open the sign-in page without signing in and check that every control is labelled and on screen.
scenarios.pass: the email field, the password field and the Sign in button are all labelled and visible without scrolling sideways.

scenarios.name: Add a todo with a priority
scenarios.description: Sign in, then add a todo called "Buy milk" with priority High.
scenarios.pass: "Buy milk" appears in the list with High priority.

scenarios.name: Complete and delete a todo
scenarios.description: Sign in, add a todo, mark it complete, then delete it.
scenarios.pass: the todo shows as done after completing it, and is gone from the list after deleting it.
